title: StreamersTip Tippy Context + Action Layer v1
description: Shared web + Flutter contract. Tippy always receives surface context. Tippy only surfaces that context when it improves the current interaction. Phase 1 is inbound snapshots. Phases 2–5 are documented, not implied as shipped.
principle: Tippy should always have context. Tippy should only surface context when it improves the current interaction.

phases.1: Context awareness — surfaces pass TippySurfaceSnapshot automatically
phases.2: Dynamic actions generated from the situation
phases.4: Proactive intelligence with confidence/importance — do not start before phases 1–3
phases.5: Daily operating layer (briefing, what changed, autonomous prep)

inbound.whatAmIDoing: Current task on that surface (tab, draft, selected item)
inbound.relevantData: Facts only. Never invented metrics. Primitives only (string | number | boolean | null).
inbound.availableActions: What Tippy may do here (id + label)

activityTruth.placement: Sibling of surface_snapshot_v1. Do not nest evidence objects inside relevantData.
activityTruth.contains: Facts and provenance only. Never conclusions such as the plan is stale.
rules: Reconcile only when uncertainty affects the decision.
activityTruth.phase: 1.5 — judgment and qualified language. Phase 2 executes repair actions.

outbound.judgment: What Tippy would or would not do
outbound.shouldSurface: Whether to show this now. Greeting and low confidence stay silent.

greetingRule: A greeting alone is Dialogue. Snapshot is still attached. Do not dump the snapshot.
